beats: Sati honours Shiva against her father
Shiva carries his grief across the worlds
Where she falls, the Devi stays

story.title: The story of the Shakti Peeths

beats.line: Sati gives up her body to honour Shiva
In grief, Shiva wanders across the worlds
Wherever a part of her falls, a shrine arises
Each Peeth keeps its Devi and a guardian Bhairava
